c.h: This guide describes the most effective methods to train the Agility skill. The experience rate estimates in this guide do not incorporate the use of any experience boosting items or bonus experience. Training the Agility skill often involves completing laps of agility courses composed of series of obstacles that grant Agility experience when traversed successfully. Typically, players are rewarded with an additional, larger amount of Agility experience for completing a full lap of an agility course, passing all obstacles successfully. During training, players should repeat any obstacles that they fail until they are successful, to receive the lap bonus (this does not apply to Anachronia lap completion or triggering talent scout encounters). As players level up Agility, they gain access to agility courses which award greater amounts of experience. Levelling up Agility also decreases a player's chance of failing during Agility activities where there is a chance of being unsuccessful.

Start training at the basic Gnome Stronghold Agility Course. You will not take damage on the basic course as it is not possible to fail any of the obstacles. The base experience per hour is around 13,928.5, based on a lap time of 33.6 seconds including the time taken to run back to the first obstacle.

At level 25 move to playing Werewolf Skullball. You will need to have completed Creature of Fenkenstrain so that you can use the ring of charos to bypass the werewolf to enter the course. Complete the course by tapping, kicking, and shooting the skullball through the ten skeletal goals before sending the ball into the final goal. 1,200 experience is gained if you finish the course in less than 3 minutes. If you can do this consistently you will gain around 28,800 experience an hour. 1,000 experience is gained if completing the course in more than 3 minutes; equivalent to 20,000 experience an hour.

With at least level 30 Agility, players can begin training at the Penguin Agility Course. Partial completion of the Cold War quest, up until the point where the player learns how to make a clockwork suit, is required for this method of training. You must be wearing the suit to use the Agility course. Some obstacles on this course can be failed, so you may want to bring some food or another method to restore lifepoints. Using this course you should gain approximately 40,500 experience an hour.

At level 35 Agility switch to the basic Barbarian Outpost Agility Course. You must complete the Bar Crawl miniquest to access the course. Some obstacles on this course can be failed, so you may want to bring some food or another method to restore lifepoints. Around 42,000 experience an hour can be gained by completing this course.

At level 48 Agility players can use the Ape Atoll Agility Course if they have partially completed Monkey Madness. A medium or small ninja monkey greegree must be worn while training at the course. Completing the course gives around 49,200 experience an hour.

At level 52 Agility, players should start training at the Wilderness Agility Course. Failure is common at these levels, so it is recommended to bring food, or another method to regain life points. Damage from failure is based on a percentage of remaining health, thus keeping your health around 25% is ideal. The experience per hour at this course is around 51,390. 5% additional experience can be gained on completing a lap if the player has the Wilderness sword 2, obtained from completing the medium Wilderness achievements, or better equipped or in the backpack. The Wilderness sword and Double XP effect do stack.

c.t: Levels 60-65: Bandos's Throne Room Agility Course
c.h:
After completing The Chosen Commander quest, you can complete the Bandos's Throne Room Agility Course. The course requires level 60 in Ranged and Strength, as well as Agility, and an enhanced grappling hook or mithril grapple. The course involves grappling between statues and grants experience in Ranged and Strength in addition to around 60,171 Agility experience an hour.

Alternatively you can use the Werewolf Agility Course. This is located in the same area as Werewolf Skullball so you will need to have completed Creature of Fenkenstrain to access it, using the ring of charos to bypass the werewolf at the entrance. This course gives around 60,000 experience an hour.
c.a: Levels 60-65: Bandos's Throne Room Agility Course

c.h: At level 65 switch to the Het's Oasis Agility Course. Training on this course gives around 70,114 Agility experience an hour. Players can fail obstacles on the course. Each obstacle failed reduces the amount of experience gained from completing the final obstacle by 1% per fail. Crocodile shortcuts can appear on the east and west sides of the course (approximately every 10 minutes). Piece of Het can be gained after completing an obstacles; 200 of these can be used to full repair the Statue of Het. Fully completing the statue increases experienced gained from the Agility course, and other skilling activities in the area, by 10%.

At level 70 complete the advanced section of the Anachronia Agility Course. Completing the north-east section (C) is recommended as it the shortest of two advanced sections and has no risk of being stunned by dinosaurs. Repeatedly complete this section of the course for around 78,000 experience an hour. When learning the course, it helps to look out for white markings on signs and obstacles and to look for a mud-coloured path. There is always a mud-coloured path when the next obstacle is not close enough to be seen on the same screen. There is a small chance to fail each obstacle, which will deal 5% of the player's current health as damage, but the obstacle will not have to be repeated and will still give full experience.

It is recommended to use Surge and Dive or Bladed Dive, as well as the Mobile perk or Shadow's Grace relic power, to move around the course quicker. You may randomly receive 1–3 codex pages along with other rewards when traversing obstacles. Having at least tier two luck improves the chance of getting pages. During the Roar of Osseous players gain +1 codex pages whenever they receive a drop, bringing the amount received to 2–4 codex pages. 25% increased Agility is also gained while the roar is active.

At level 77 Agility, players can train at the Hefin Agility Course. Completion of the Plague's End quest is required to access it as it is located within Prifddinas. The amount of experience gained from traversing obstacles on the course and bonus experience awarded for completing a full lap of the course increases every 5 Agility levels. At level 77 the experience rate is around 102,857 experience an hour. It is not possible to fail obstacles on this course.

The course has a unique "velocity" system where a bar is filled as the player traverses the course's obstacles, becoming full on approximately every other lap of the course that the player completes. When the bar is full, the next obstacle on the course will be completed automatically. Shortcuts have a chance of spawning when a lap of the course is completed. These can be used to complete the next lap of the course more quickly. Players have a chance of obtaining a reward each time that a lap is completed. These can include small Agility XP lamps and Hefin course multipliers. The Voice of Seren also provides benefits for players training at the Hefin course. As well as receiving 20% additional experience in Agility, players will receive Prayer experience at a rate equivalent to 25% of the base Agility experience that they gain. The Voice of Seren also increases the player's chance of spawning shortcuts and doubles the rate at which velocity is gained while it is active.

It is possible to right-click the next obstacle while viewing these cutscenes for all the course's obstacles except the roof obstacle; this can be used to begin obstacles more quickly and decrease the time taken to complete the lap. Players may also complete faster laps by right-clicking the square from which the course's first obstacle is attempted, 2 squares south of the western side of the walkway obstacle, and using the "walk here" option before using the obstacle; this causes the player's character to run, rather than walk, towards the obstacle.

Spirit moths in Havenhythe can be caught barehanded with level 80 Agility and 85 Hunter. While catching the moths barehanded 355 Agility experience is gained for each moth caught successfully, but their usual charm drops are greatly reduced. Catching them gives around 150,000 Agility experience an hour.

Spirit moths are spawned by searching hollow trees (not stumps) in Highweald Forest. Tellervo's lantern may rarely be found while searching the trees. When equipped, moths will fly towards the player, no longer attempt to flee after a failed catch attempt, and sometimes will be automatically caught. Items which increase success rate while hunting are also beneficial to the rate at which Agility experience is gained from the moths.

At level 85 the complete Anachronia Agility Course can be trained at for around 210,000 experience an hour. Each obstacle on the Agility course provides 22 experience. Finishing each of the course's seven sections gives additional experience. Completing an entire circuit of the course yields an additional 21,736 experience, for a total of 28,000 experience for an entire lap. There is a small chance to fail each obstacle, which will deal 5% of the player's current health as damage, but the obstacle will not have to be repeated and will still give full experience.

Level 85 is only required for a short section of the course so players may wish to start training here from level 80 onwards. Players with 80 Agility may pass this section using 1-2 bites of summer pie, which boosts their Agility level to 85 and is relatively cheap and easy to acquire. The Agility boost from a god banner also boosts from level 80 to 85, and lasts thirty minutes, though it can only be used once per day.

It is recommended to use Surge and Dive or Bladed Dive, as well as the Mobile perk or Shadow's Grace relic power, to move around the course quicker. You may randomly receive 1–3 codex pages along with other rewards when traversing obstacles. Having at least tier two luck improves the chance of getting pages. Completing the entire course awards 10 codex pages. During the Roar of Osseous players gain +1 codex pages whenever they receive a drop, bringing the amount received to 2–4 codex pages when completing an obstacle and 11 pages when completing the course. 25% increased Agility is also gained while the roar is active. Upgrading your spa at Anachronia base camp increases your base Agility experience gain between 5-10%, depending on the spa tier.

Players can do an Agility performance at the Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distraction and Diversion once per week. The Agility performance can be started by entering the changing booth in the Agility performance area, transporting the player to the high wire. During the performance, players have 10 attempts to perform up to 10 different tricks. Agility experience is received upon the first successful attempt of each trick that the player performs. Repeating a trick does not grant additional experience. Each trick has a recommended Agility level to attempt, however the level is not required to perform the trick, as it is possible to succeed or fail a trick at any Agility level. When a trick is performed that has a higher recommended Agility level than the player has, the experience received will be the same as that given for performing a trick with half the recommended Agility level, rounded down.

  • To gain the most experience from the Agility performance players should begin by performing the highest recommended level trick for their current Agility level, and work down to the trick with a recommended level half of their current Agility level.
  • After this players should perform any tricks with a recommended Agility level which is greater than their current Agility level and then finally perform any tricks with a recommended level of less than half of their current Agility level.
  • The Distraction and Diversion's interface will display the recommended Agility level for the performance's tricks, as well as show which tricks the player has performed successfully.
  • Players can receive a total of 13,749.5 experience, in about 1 minute, if they successfully perform all tricks with level 99 Agility or higher.
  • With completion of the Back to the Freezer quest, players may gain up to 1.5 times as much experience from each trick at level 99.

At level 65, players can gain a cap of 800,000 experience on the Manual Auto-cycles in The Empty Throne Room, located in the Varrock Dig Site. This is a fully AFK activity, but rewards a very low amount of experience per hour compared to completing laps of the Het's Oasis Agility Course at level 65. If players wish to be efficient, they can move between the empowered auto-cycles (which have a purple glow under them) to gain increased experience; the cycle that is empowered changes every 42 seconds (70 game ticks). The amount of experience that has been gained using cycles can be checked by speaking to Celia Diggory outside of the throne room.
